summary: Russian Iskander missiles struck a military exhibition near Kiev, detaining the organizer and killing Colonel Sirenko, while Ukrainian forces allegedly attacked tourist bases in Zaporizhzhie, killing eight. Multiple reactive UAVs and KAB precision-guided bombs have been launched across Ukraine, including in Sumy, Poltava, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia. Threats of ballistic Iskander-M missiles from occupied Crimea and Taganrog further raise the risk of long-range strikes.
key_points: Russian Iskander missiles struck a military exhibition near Kiev, detaining the organizer and killing Colonel Eduard Sirenko; 300 people attended and the nearest shelter was 100m away. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31920, @ukr_leaks_eng/31906)

Polish defense company employee was killed during a missile strike on a drone exhibition near Kiev; the event was held at the CSA Open Air training ground near Vasylkov Air Base. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31901)
Two gas stations in the Poltava region were attacked, with no further details provided. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31903)

Zaporizhzhia city suffered an attack with nine people needing medical help, including three children, and one woman died; Russian forces also launched KABs at the city. (Source: @UkraineNow/82921, @kpszsu/70098)
Ukrainian forces allegedly attacked tourist bases in Zaporizhzhie region, killing eight including two children and injuring fourteen, including three children. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31919)
Alushta region declared an emergency zone due to lack of electricity, activating emergency mode. (Source: @eRadarrua/102622)
Threats of ballistic weapons from south and north were reported, though no specific details were provided. (Source: @kpszsu/70067, @kpszsu/70091)
Reactive UAVs were observed moving along the Kherson line westward toward Mykolaiv and Odessa, with additional UAVs heading to Mykolaiv. (Source: @kpszsu/70049, @kpszsu/70052)

sections.threat_assessment: The recent Iskander missile strike on a Ukrainian exhibition and the alleged Ukrainian attack on tourist bases in Zaporizhzhie indicate a sharp escalation of hostilities. Persistent UAV activity across multiple regions, coupled with repeated KAB precision‑guided bomb launches, demonstrates an intensifying aerial campaign. The reported threats of Iskander‑M ballistic missiles from occupied Crimea and Taganrog further elevate the risk of long‑range strikes, potentially expanding the operational theater.
sections.regional_response: Kazakhstan’s President Tokayev proposed freezing the conflict and returning to an Istanbul‑style formula, signaling a diplomatic push for de‑escalation. Russia’s ban on gasoline export and continued strikes on Ukrainian ports reflect a strategy to pressure Ukraine economically and militarily. The Ukrainian military’s reported attacks on tourist bases and the ongoing exhibition incidents highlight a shift toward targeting civilian and symbolic sites.
sections.intelligence_notes: The upcoming IRON DEMO 2026 defense exhibition in Lviv, scheduled for August 28‑29, will attract over 150 Ukrainian and foreign defense companies and 2,000 industry representatives, underscoring Ukraine’s continued efforts to showcase defense capabilities. The repeated missile and UAV attacks on exhibitions near Kiev emphasize the vulnerability of such events to Russian strikes. Monitoring of KAB launches and Iskander‑M threats remains critical for assessing future operational risks.
